contribution_requirements: Stack: React (Vite) + Express + MongoDB, JavaScript, ES Modules. Styling: CSS Modules, one .module.css per page or component. Client flow: page → component → hook → api function → axios instance. Pages never call axios directly. All API errors use shape { message: '...' }. No files outside agreed structure without asking.
key_patterns: All API modules import from src/api/axiosInstance.js. Error handling pattern: catch(err) => err.response?.data?.message || 'Fallback message'. CSS Modules used per-page and per-component. BrowserRouter is in main.jsx — App.jsx must NOT add a second BrowserRouter. MUI ThemeProvider + CssBaseline go in App.jsx. AuthContext wraps everything in App.jsx. main.jsx already has BrowserRouter, so App.jsx provides ThemeProvider+AuthProvider only.
